ai.seo_question: What does the command 'Glorify your Lord' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse follows the command to purify one's garment, shifting focus from external cleanliness to the spiritual elevation of the Divine. Shia exegetes highlight this as a foundational declaration of Tawhid, establishing that recognizing Allah's absolute greatness is the prerequisite for all subsequent acts of worship and prophetic duty.
